Lines 814–830 classify product masks, nonfinite inputs, and both physicality bounds per pixel. Tests at test_polarimetry_stokes.py:325–566 exercise these rules. checks.evidence: test_polarimetry_stokes.py:590–638 defines and checks the mixed 2x3 array, including F2 inputs under a product mask and subsequently unmasked. Assertions cover shapes, powers, CPR, states, reasons, and NaN rather than zero for unavailable ratios. Runtime verification is prohibited in this read-only review.
